user.title: SMGD DriveLog
user.description: Enter the address of your SMGD DriveLog and an API token with the "ha" scope (created in DriveLog under Settings → API tokens).

data_description.notify_service: The phone that receives notifications, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_iphone. Used if no device is selected in DriveLog.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: DriveLog at {url} rejected the API token. Create a new token with the "ha" scope and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of your SMGD DriveLog, e.g. https://smgd.se/drivelog. Leave the token empty to keep the saved one.

error.invalid_url: Invalid address – it must start with http:// or https://.
error.invalid_auth: The API token is invalid or revoked.
error.missing_scope: The API token lacks the "ha" scope.
error.invalid_service: Choose a service of the form notify.mobile_app_<device>.
error.wrong_account: The address belongs to a different DriveLog user.

abort.already_configured: This DriveLog user is already configured.

data.send_feedback: Show feedback when an answer could not be applied
data.collect_route: Collect the phone's route while driving
data.location_interval: Ask the phone for its position while driving (seconds)

data_description.notify_service: Used if no device is selected in DriveLog.
data_description.route_entity: Only positions within a trip are sent to DriveLog. Empty = the phone that receives the notifications.
data_description.location_interval: How often the phone is asked for a new position while the car is driving. iOS may skip some requests at short intervals.

error.invalid_service: Choose a service of the form notify.mobile_app_<device>.

flush_queue.name: Flush response queue
flush_queue.description: Sends queued answers to DriveLog immediately and fetches new notifications.

no_phone.title: DriveLog has questions but no phone is selected
no_phone.description: SMGD DriveLog has notifications waiting, but no phone (notify.mobile_app_…) is selected. Choose the phone in DriveLog under Integrations → Home Assistant, or in this integration's options. Nothing is lost: the questions wait in DriveLog.
